You will join
A forward-thinking team committed to leveraging the latest SAP innovations within a dynamic working environment. You can expect challenging projects, a supportive culture, and the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise solutions.

What we offer

Explore a world of opportunities with us. Look ahead with us and help shape innovative solutions to make our world more sustainable and life healthier, more vibrant and more comfortable. At Evonik, you have the chance to explore, thrive, and grow alongside 33,000 colleagues. Among attractive career paths and high-quality development programs, we not only offer performance-based remuneration and occupational health benefits but also hybrid and flexible working environments with #SmartWork. Bring your fresh perspective, develop your strengths, break out your mold, and find a career that fits your dreams with us.

Click on the link below to learn what our employees have to say about Evonik:

https://careers.evonik.com/en/about/meet-the-team/

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and implement scalable SAP solutions, leveraging object-oriented ABAP, Core Data Services (CDS) views, OData services, and SAP Fiori applications.

  • Develop and enhance business processes on SAP S/4HANA, incorporating Clean Core principles for a sustainable and upgrade-ready landscape.

  • Integrate and extend SAP solutions using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and S/4HANA Extensibility options to drive innovation and flexibility.

  • Collaborate across functional and technical teams to analyze requirements, architect best-fit solutions, and deliver high-quality results.

  • Lead technical projects from concept through delivery, mentoring junior developers and ensuring coding standards are met.

  • Stay current with SAP’s latest technologies, cloud offerings, and development methodologies to proactively support digital transformation.

  • Contribute to enterprise architecture by defining guidelines, documentation, and reusable components for SAP extension and integration scenarios.

  • Participate in workshops and stakeholder meetings, translating business needs into robust technical designs.

REQUIREMENTS

  • University Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • Extensive experience in object-oriented ABAP and modern SAP development (CDS Views, OData, Fiori/UI5).

  • Strong understanding of Clean Core strategies, S/4HANA Extensibility, and SAP Public Cloud architectures.

  • Practical experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), including integration and extension frameworks.

  • Hands-on expertise in designing and developing API-based services and user interfaces in SAP environments.

  • Solid problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

  • Proven ability to deliver complex projects independently and guide others when needed.

  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Your Application
 

To ensure that your application is proceeded as quickly as possible and to protect the environment, please apply online via our careers portal. Further information about Evonik as Employer can be found at www.evonik.com/en/careers.html. 

Please address your application to the Talent Acquisition Manager, stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.

Kelly Wong [C]

Job Title : Assistant Manager - Formulation Development

Business Line : Health Care RCI

Work Location : Thane

Entity : Evonik India


Key Responsibilities :


  • Conduct formulations experiments
  • Troubleshoot technical problems related to the manufacturing processes and formulations independently, in order to meet the project goals.
  • Communicate with the project manager(s) and other stakeholders on technical matters. Present technical data with due consideration to the connect with the overall technical goal & business connect of the project.
  • Send inhouse samples for analysis to analytical department.
  • Document the experiment completely on time.
  • Load batches for stability studies & document the same.
  • Preparation of bio batch & all documents related to the same.
  • Prepare trial reports & and other documents related to the project.
  • Material destruction coordination within RCI for destruction of experimental materials quarterly with due documentation in place.
  • Play active role in experimental data generation aiming at protection of IP for the organization.
  • Update project specific technical details in Accolade system.
  • Generate new technical ideas of business relevance.
  • Handle additional administrative KRAs as assigned.
  • Collaborate with scientific community within and outside the organization to frame technical literature such as book chapters and articles in scientific journals.

Education & Experience required :


  • M. Pharm. in Pharmaceutics and/or PhD in Pharmaceutical sciences with at least 3 years of experience in carrying out formulation development activities in lab.
  • Sound technical knowledge related to the oral drug delivery domain.
  • Good analytical skills to help troubleshoot the technical problems. encountered during project execution.
  • Independent decision-making ability on technical matters in order to meet the technical goal(s) of projects.
  • Ability to solve the technical challenges experienced during day to day working in lab, independently with the minimum involvement of the manager/ supervisor.
  • Good communication skills.


Your Application
 

To ensure that your application is proceeded as quickly as possible and to protect the environment, please apply online via our careers portal. Further information about Evonik as Employer can be found at www.evonik.com/en/careers.html. 

Please address your application to the Talent Acquisition Manager, stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.

Job Title : Technical Marketing & Business Development Manager

Reporting to : Head of Sales India & Global Director Oils & Fats Catalysts (OFC)

Business Line : Catalysts

Entity : Evonik Catalysts India

Work Location : Dombivli


Purpose of the Position :


  • The position ensures the sustainable short- and long-term growth of the BL’s business (mainly but not limited to PL Lifescience ) in India. It ensures that marketing and business development activities in India are coordinated with the BL’s global strategy and with respective activities and positions in other regions.
  • It supports the regional BL Head with transferring the global PLs strategies into the assigned region.

Key Responsibilities :


  • Evaluate and assess business opportunities for the BL products and joint development projects in the life science/fine chemicals industry and translate global BL/PL strategy into regional marketing activities and develop suitable implementation strategies
  • Define and lead or accompany technical development projects according to customer needs, growth potential and profitability. Initiate and support target- and customer-oriented developments of products and services, according to local market needs and in alignment with the global product group management
  • Develop and drive regional market communication campaigns for PL LSP’s offerings and applications, supported by communication specialists. Identify and manage potential collaboration partners in the industry or in academia (e.g. for development projects or for testing purposes)
  • Cooperate with and guide the local sales organization and align with the local RDI organization to achieve the PL’s business targets. Process technical customer requests, coordinate projects with global product group management and align corresponding tasks and activities with RDI and AT
  • Monitor market trends and developments in the regional life science and fine chemicals industry, e.g. capacity expansions, new catalyst developments, regulatory aspects, customer/prospects activities. Collect and consolidate information on market dynamics (value, innovation, business models, outsourcing, imports/exports, regulatory etc.)

 Education & Experience required :


  • Graduate in Organic Chemistry, Catalysis, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific discipline.
  • MBA in Marketing, Business Management, or Strategy (added advantage).

Minimum 10-12 years of relevant industry experience in:


  • Specialty Chemicals
  • Life Sciences
  • Fine Chemicals
  • Catalyst Technologies
  • Pharmaceutical Ingredients
  • Process Chemicals

  • Ability to translate global business strategies into regional market plans.
  • Experience conducting: Market assessments, Competitor analysis, Voice-of-customer studies, Industry segmentation.

Your Application

Job Title : Head - RDI Catalysts India

Entity : Evonik Catalysts India Pvt. Ltd.

Work Location : Dombivli


Purpose of the Position :


  • Ensures that an India innovation strategy is aligned and developed with the innovation programs, continuously improved and implemented in the field of R&D, applied technology and technical services,
  • Contributes to the technical and commercial competitiveness of the business and to profitable growth,
  • Ensures the processing of the necessary research and development tasks to the required extend for the successful implementation of technical projects of multiple strategic levels and timelines,
  • Ensures that new businesses with internal and external partners are developed for the business line and Evonik Industries, are coordinated and are successfully rolled-out and implemented,
  • Significantly contributes to the development of skilled employees and high performing technical teams and contributes to the long term economic success and the growth of the company.

Key Responsibilities :


Managing a team of scientists and engineers responsible for crucial technical processes in the entire India region. Leading a team in a complex international matrix organization with partly divergent goals, covering the full technologies’ and applications’ portfolio of high importance to the business line. Responsibility to ensure skilled technical support to business and production and development resources to the innovation programs, thus to assure the business’ technical and commercial competitiveness.


  • Responsible for building capabilities for the entire regional innovation of the BL and implementation of development frameworks for the region and, for breaking down the overall strategy by developing and delivering regional operational plans and outcomes, aligned and coordinated with the other regions,
  • responsible for the delivery of the regional part of the organization's innovation project management program and thus for a significant operational area, aligned and coordinated with the other regions,
  • communicating the actions needed to implement the business line's strategy and business plan within the team; explaining the relationship to the broader organization's mission, vision and values; motivating people to commit to these and to doing extraordinary things to achieve regional business goals,
  • leading a team of R&D, applied technology and technical services professionals, overseeing innovation and other technical projects and studies in order to investigate relationships, solve technical problems, and develop new solutions for technology and applications in alignment with the programs and the other regions,
  • expertise based authority on developing appropriate plans and performing necessary actions to further improve the performance and to reduce or mitigate potential risks,
  • external representation in the region, contact to authorities on management level; negotiation and determination of cooperation agreements with company internal and external partners,
  • planning and steering of the regional innovation-, technical services- and capex-budget on cost center level and allocation of the necessary internal development resources to the programs,
  • Disciplinary, functional & ESHQ responsibility for multiple sites and responsibility to implement a suitable subordinate organization, responsibility for planning of the development of personnel and infrastructure, including selection of personnel and cost responsibility.

Education, Certification and/or Relevant Experience Required


  • Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry with expertise in Catalysis, Materials Science, Petrochemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Research & Development, Technology Development or Innovation Management within the Catalysts industry.
  • Proven leadership experience of at least 8-10 years managing multidisciplinary teams of scientistsists

Job Title : Business Manager - Oil Additives

Entity : Evonik India Pvt. Ltd.

Work Location : Thane


Purpose of the Position :

  • Account management for Business Line Oil Additives for the Indian subcontinent (India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka);
  • First level for customer: sales, technical representation and service

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a primary salesperson to direct customers and distributors;
  • Understand customers’ commercial and technical needs and opportunities;
  • Fulfill customers’ needs through budgeted resources of local organization;
  • Develop the ideas for customer specific local strategies and implementation;
  • Work closely with global Product line team and related functions to set strategy for customers and market;
  • Work with existing customers and search for potential customers in the country;
  • Close liaison with OEMs;
  • Project Management;
  • Generate, evaluate & report market & competitive information to ensure competitive advantage;
  • Provide high quality & complete data input to ensure a proper market & account management;
  • Conduct and control all elements of basic sales process, such as: offers and contracts, incl. their documentation, credit management; solve open points in processing and logistics;
  • Negotiate of contract terms (with regard to) such as quantity, payment terms and conditions or delivery terms and conditions;
  • Negotiate the price (within the price range);
  • Prepare and negotiate sales or other product related contracts;
  • Decide on discounts, rebates, etc.;
  • Taking responsibility of recovery of accounts receivables;
  • Responsible for dunning process;
  • Discuss individual complaint procedure with the customer;
  • Provide individual conflict resolution to the customer;
  • Analysis of market development and potentials, propose ideas for improving own market position and exploitation of potentials;
  • Observe, analyze and report competitors´ marketing activities and strategies (e.g. products, personnel, processes) to support competitive benchmarking.

Education, Certification and/or Relevant Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in the lubricants and/or lubricant additives industry.

Additional Skills and Competencies Required

  • Strong understanding of the decision-making, procurement, and negotiation processes within Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), including experience with contracts, tenders, MoUs, and related commercial agreements.
  • High level of technical and product knowledge in lubricants and lubricant additives, with the ability to effectively communicate product value propositions to customers.
  • Established industry network and market knowledge across allied sectors such as: Alternative Energy, Machine Tools, Textile Industry, Thermal Fluids and Other related industrial segments
  • Strong commercial acumen, customer relationship management, and negotiation skills.
  • Demonstrates the highest standards of integrity, ethics, compliance, and professional conduct.

Your Application
 

To ensure that your application is proceeded as quickly as possible and to protect the environment, please apply online via our careers portal. Further information about Evonik as Employer can be found at www.evonik.com/en/careers.html. 

Please address your application to the Talent Acquisition Manager, stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.

Job Title : Associate Director – ESH

Reporting to : Head of Operations

Entity : Evonik Catalysts India Pvt. Ltd.

Work location : Dombivli

 

Purpose of the position :

  • To standardize ESH practices at ECI.
  • To develop, implement, and drive strategic and operational ESHQ leadership.
  • The incumbent sets the direction for the ESHQ program to improve or introduce new policies, set quality standards, procedures, practices, parameters and manages its execution.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain a safe working environment at site.
  • Implementation of Evonik’s Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) Policy. Planning, establishing, implementing, and maintaining a variety of Occupational health, safety, environmental programs to assure the highest possible degree of safety for employees.
  • Responsible for overall development, implementation, and maintenance of the organization’s Quality Management System (QMS) & Environment Management System (EMS).
  • Direct environmental compliance programs related to hazardous wastes, air permitting, and water pollution control.
  • Design & impart training to nurture an Injury free Organization.
  • Lead and support safety initiatives and processes to drive towards zero recordable injuries.
  • Ensure effective implementation of QMS as per ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001 to achieve set objectives.
  • Assist in new employee occupational health, safety and environmental orientation. Ensure periodical health checkup of employees.
  • Conduct Safety Committee meetings. Lead and support safety initiatives and processes to drive towards zero recordable injuries.
  • Act as a core Emergency Response Team member to handle emergency.
  • Implementation and maintenance of the environmental management system.
  • Continuous follow up and enhancing the S.A.F.E. score.
  • Practice of ensuring that a workplace is continually safe.
  • Interview employees to obtain information about work environments and workplace incidents.
  • EHSQ budget preparation and monitoring.
  • Monitoring, supporting, guiding for meeting timeline of all the EHS activities.
  • Ensure promotion of customer focus within the department, as applicable. 
  • Ensure compliance of Safety standards at workplace including PPE’s in working environment.
  • Responsible for handling ESHQ audit and coordinating other site audits.  
  • Coordination with statutory authorities for regulatory topics.
  • Manage the site security topics

 

Catalysts India ESH Coordinator-

  • Standardize practices at site.
  • Develop and monitor ESH objectives and targets.
  • Support ESH due diligence for the site.
  • Investigate major incidents at Company and report to management.
  • Supporting APS and corporate ESH for execution of ESTER project at site.
  • Follow-up on audit observations and recommendations.
  • Establish ESH communication within site to share best practices and lesson learned.
  • Drive ‘Safety at Evonik- Basic Principles of Safe Behavior’ program implementation at site.
  • Ensure ‘Emergency Communication’ team established at site  and known of press communication tools. Provide support to team in case of emergency situations.

Education & Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Health & Environment (SHE), Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or an equivalent discipline.
  • 10-12 years of relevant experience in Environment, Health & Safety (EHS), including sound knowledge of safety, health, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Technical & Functional Expertise

  • In-depth understanding of EHS regulations, compliance requirements, and industry best practices.
  • Experience in implementing and monitoring safety, health, and environmental management systems.
  • Proven ability to liaise and coordinate with government authorities, regulatory bodies, and external agencies.
  • Knowledge of risk assessment, incident investigation, audit management, and compliance reporting.

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organizational, planning, and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a self-organized manner.
  • Experience collaborating effectively with remote and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong team player with excellent communication and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive EHS initiatives across the organization.

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Hands-on experience in a chemical, manufacturing, or process industry environment.
  • Strong regulatory and statutory compliance exposure.
  • Demonstrated success in managing multiple stakeholders, including government and regulatory authorities.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of driving a strong safety culture within the organization.
